recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core source edit is needed for this seed; future edits to the extension definition itself should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-13895 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification for the STU3 core issue that goal-pertainsToGoal implied a Goal-only scope even though the extension applies at Resource level. The accepted change was to move the extension to the Resource extension spreadsheet so it became resource-pertainsToGoal, with wording about resources related to measurement, achievement, or progress toward a referenced Goal.
initial_application: Git commit 44fb1e203e958046ffed413179eb2fb5e23c2fce explicitly applied the issue by moving the extension from the Goal extension spreadsheet to the Resource extension spreadsheet and updating the CarePlan extension link.
additional_context: Current FHIR core source documents that all extensions moved to the hl7.fhir.uv.extensions package. The FHIR Extension Pack checkout contains StructureDefinition-resource-pertainsToGoal with the Resource-scoped canonical URL, fixedUri, context, and requested definition text. Later FHIR-44770 corrected the externalized extension title to Resource Pertains To Goal, and later FHIR-53828 added current Goal narrative awareness of this extension.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current core build-scope references in Goal notes, CarePlan comments, and source/oids.ini use resource-pertainsToGoal; the old goal-pertainsToGoal URL appears only in historical release archives; and the authoritative current definition is already correct in the extension-pack checkout.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-extensions issue corrected the externalized resource-pertainsToGoal display name/title to Resource Pertains To Goal, confirming the Resource-scoped interpretation.
Later core Goal issue added current narrative awareness of resource-pertainsToGoal, confirming the renamed extension remains the intended current mechanism for goal-evaluation links.
